awards.name: FRC Regional Excellence in Engineering Award

rationale.intuition: Cooper Union Engineering admit rate ~16-18% (slightly higher than Architecture's ~9%); SAT mid-50% 1350-1530. Strong STEM profile + USACO Gold + FPGA project + ED is well-aligned. Cooper requires Engineering Question Set (essay-based interview-style submission) but no Hometest like Architecture — academic profile is closer to a normal STEM-school evaluation. Industry: 20-40% for top-quartile stats + STEM-strong activities + ED. Engine treats as SPECIALTY — normal path; should produce meaningful prediction unlike the Architecture case (078).
